label: PF Backlog 222
title: Backend: capability-gated pipeline composition - inject media/IoT stages (0f, 4m, media-QA) + agents into the existing 0..13b order per enabled pack
body:
## Problem / why
BI-0190 defines media agents and BI-0189 defines packs, but nothing says HOW the orchestrator weaves
optional stages (`0f` capability strategy, `4m` media production, media-QA in `5/6`) and their agents into
the FIXED existing 0..13b stage order. Without this, media support would fork the pipeline instead of
plugging into it, and a non-media project could regress.

## Goal & value
One composition layer that, given the enabled capability packs, produces the run's effective stage order
and agent roster by ADDING optional stages/agents - leaving a non-media run byte-identical to today.

## In scope
- `core/capability_packs.py` (single writer) reads `config/capability-packs.json` and exposes
  `effective_stages(base=pipeline-definition)`, `effective_agents(base_roster)`, `enabled_tools/models`.
- Optional stages are declared in the pack with an ANCHOR (insert-after stage id) + `requires` modalities,
  e.g. `0f` after `0a`; `4m` after `4-0` (and per-iteration media steps); media-QA hooks into `5`,`6`.
- Roster injection: pack agents appended to the affected stages' `ideal_flow` only when enabled.
- Executor/stage_runner/agent_runner consume the EFFECTIVE definition (not the raw file) per run.
- Guard: with no packs enabled, `effective_*` == base (asserted in tests).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- No pack -> effective stage order + roster identical to `pipeline-definition.json` (regression guard).
- Image/video pack -> `0f` and `4m` present in order, media agents on the right stages, existing stages intact.
- Disabling a pack removes its stages/agents with no residue.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: composition decision table (packs -> stages/agents), anchor insertion, idempotency.
- Integration: run an app idea vs a reels idea; diff the effective stage list.
